methods.description: Choose the same multiple of the pronumeral to add/subtract on both sides so it occurs on only one side with a positive coefficient; then use inverse operations. Set expressions equal when asked for equal values.
Expand every term in the brackets on one or both sides, then gather the pronumeral with a positive coefficient and solve by equal inverse operations.
Collect like terms within a side first; then gather the pronumeral with a positive coefficient and solve the remaining equation.
